author: Cody Carroll
text: Jason was awesome came out and cleaned out our septic tank and system with ease. Very professional and explained to me what he was doing and did a very thorough job. I would recommend him for cleaning your septic tanks.. I called around other company’s and his prices were the best or if not the same.

author: Derek Mobley
text: Professional, technical, and thorough. The detailed inspection report he sent me, on the same day as the pump and inspection, was very clear and informative. He saved me from making a $358,000 mistake. He even called to discuss the situation and see if I had any questions. I'll never go to anyone else in the future.

author: Joshua Mccoy
text: Jason is a septic pro! Got my septic back up and running on Sunday in the middle of the rain! Installed a brand new pump and ran new electrical wire all the way to the system. Fixed someone else’s faulty work. Great job!

author: Ford M
text: Jason with Pro-Tec Specific was great! They were out here fast for an emergency and got everything taken care of quickly, cleanly, and was very informative about my septic system. Would recommend!

author: sage corbett
text: Jason at Pro-Tec Septic was extremely helpful and professional. His inspection caught an important detail most would have missed about the permitting of the septic tank.
